_readme: Zoho WorkDrive team folder -> Vault project map (M09). Each entry syncs the folder's files into Items in project_id. folder_id is the WorkDrive resource id shown in the folder URL. Entries whose folder_id starts with EXAMPLE, or with enabled=false, are skipped. type forces a Vault item type for the whole folder (e.g. contract for Legal/); omit it to infer from file names. legal_tag is optional (default: the project's default tag). books maps Zoho Books customers to projects for src/ingest/zoho-books.ts.
